findings: The family colour model binds all 48 prepared RGBA hashes and full multi-source ownership; it cannot describe the repainted gait using only the original three PNG hashes.
Walking masks follow measured waist seams and own the calves separately from complete boot regions.

Reusing old mask output would preserve inherited wrong shirt/pant boundaries and uncoloured rear boots; exact old output is therefore required only for the 40 unaffected masks.
Fine highlight/edge ownership and complete clothing/accessory/equipment/portrait/world/motion combinations remain a separate release gate. This calibration is not a production art-perfect verdict.
